description: This file defines the Nested formatter class for SCSSPHP, a PHP library for processing SCSS stylesheets. It includes methods for formatting nested CSS rules, handling indentation, block structures, and directives.

classes.name: Nested
classes.description: A deprecated formatter class for nested SCSS rules, providing indentation and block formatting for SCSS code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the formatter with default indentation, break, and separator settings, and triggers a deprecation warning.

methods.name: indentStr
methods.description: Returns the indentation string based on current depth and indentation level.

methods.name: blockLines
methods.description: Formats the lines within a block, replacing line breaks and writing the formatted lines.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Handles the formatting of a block, managing nested depths, selectors, and child blocks.

methods.name: hasFlatChild
methods.description: Checks if a block has any child with no selectors, indicating a flat child.
